description: This file contains utility functions and interfaces for transforming chart data, extracting hooks, creating transformation results, and handling spatial data in a Superset frontend plugin.

classes.name: BaseHooks
classes.description: Interface defining hook functions for chart interactions.

classes.name: BaseTransformPropsResult
classes.description: Interface defining the structure of the transformation result object for chart data.

methods.name: extractHooks
methods.description: Extracts hook functions from ChartProps, providing default no-op functions if undefined.

methods.name: createBaseTransformResult
methods.description: Creates a transformation result object containing chart data, hooks, and viewport info.

methods.name: getRecordsFromQuery
methods.description: Retrieves data records from the first query in queriesData.

methods.name: parseMetricValue
methods.description: Parses a value into a float number, returning undefined if invalid.

methods.name: addPropertiesToFeature
methods.description: Adds properties from a data record to a feature object, excluding specified keys.

methods.name: getMetricLabelFromFormData
methods.description: Gets a metric label string from a metric value or object.
